### Rejoice in the Lord Always
Author: John Sartelle
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/rejoice-lord-always
Passage: Philippians 4:4
Points:
- Biblical joy is a divine command and daily decision rather than an involuntary emotion or genetic trait.
- Christian joy is supernatural, flowing from the Holy Spirit's presence within a reborn heart.
- Genuine joy remains constant because it is grounded in God's unchanging goodness rather than pleasant circumstances.
- Joy and sorrow can coexist because the promise of Christ's redemption comforts believers even in profound grief.
- The joy of the Lord serves as a spiritual fortress protecting Christians from cynicism and despair.

### Fight Anxiety Without Fear
Author: Ryan Shelton
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/fight-anxiety-without-fear
Passage: Philippians 4:6
Points:
- Anxiety frequently latches onto legitimate human desires and basic physical needs.
- Instead of trying to passively suppress anxious feelings, believers should actively voice their needs to God.
- Bringing specific requests to the Father serves as an offensive weapon against fear.
- Approaching prayer with thanksgiving keeps believers humble and prevents requests from becoming demanding.
- Christians do not face anxiety alone because God fights alongside them with His promises.
